image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on dark, rippling water. The duck is captured in a dynamic pose with its head tucked down towards the water and its tail feathers raised high (dabbling posture). It displays characteristic breeding plumage: an iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, and a brownish-grey patterned body. The bill is visible and appears yellow-green. The reflection of the duck is distorted in the water.
